title: pyrus humilis
intro: Pyrus humilis, commonly known as the Korean dwarf pear or Korean sand pear, is a species of pear tree native to East Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus humilis include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus humilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
